2022_281_aug_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for the Troy School District covering August 2022, carried on the Board of Education agenda for the October 18, 2022 meeting. The 25-page printout, dated 10/13/2022, itemizes every card charge by transaction date and merchant, journal-entry description (uniformly "AUG PCARD EXP"), budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credits, with posting dates ranging from 7/26/2022 through 8/25/2022. Spending is dominated by back-to-school instructional supplies, athletics equipment, facilities materials, software subscriptions and professional-association dues. The report closes with a Subtotal of 249,858.04, Credits of 4,146.09, and Total Expenses of 245,711.95.

**Document type**
Purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for the Troy School District, August 2022, presented with the Board of Education materials for the October 18, 2022 meeting. The printout runs 25 pages and each page footer carries the print date 10/13/2022 beneath the repeated header "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Aug 2022."

**Format**
Each line records: Transaction Description (transaction date plus a truncated merchant name such as "AMZN MKTP US" or "STAPLS736278"), JE Description (uniformly "AUG PCARD EXP"), Budget Unit (a fifteen-digit string, e.g. 101425221000000), A/C Code (e.g. 5110, 5990, 5000, 3220, 7410), Transaction Amount, and Credits. Transaction dates run from 7/26/2022 through 8/25/2022.

**Spending categories**
Instructional and office supplies (Amazon, Staples, Lakeshore, School Specialty, Really Good Stuff, Booksource, Barnes & Noble, Capstone, Scholastic, Stenhouse); athletics (Sports Attack, JUGS Sports, Rogue, Epic Sports, Hudl, Athlete's Connection, Soccer Master); facilities and grounds (Uline, Sunbelt Rentals, Assured Lock, Lighting Supply, Drainage Solutions, Home Depot, Lowe's, Mike Savoie); technology and subscriptions (GoTo, SolarWinds, Microsoft, Zoom, Adobe, Vimeo, Canva, SurveyMonkey, Kahoot!, Edpuzzle, Planbook.com, Smore.com, HelpCounter); and professional dues, conferences and food for staff functions.
2022_281_aug_2022_pcard_report.verbose:

Every line carries the same journal-entry description, "AUG PCARD EXP."
